review_framework: 4-question algorithmic assessment (design goal / degeneration / minimal fix / standard method)
scope_note: Algorithm design only, no numerical results; dataset still in preparation

rounds.prompt_summary: 15 algorithmic steps assessed with 4 questions each; known weaknesses from 2 prior experiment-audits embedded
rounds.overall_assessment_summary: Three design-level problems: (1) estimand identity crisis — 5 different quantities share the name 'Spearman'; (2) shrinkage used where projection is needed — Ridge alpha=1.0 on categorical confounders biases toward 'physical signal'; (3) all null distributions/baselines/controls come from different populations than the judged objects.

deliverables: Control arm matching checklist (4 control arms)
mvp_items: W1-1: alpha=0 projection replaces Ridge shrinkage
W2-1: Pure function refactoring (the only L)

wave_structure.W0: Freeze foundation (4 items, all pre-data, 2 blocking)
wave_structure.W1: Adjustment layer correctness (5 items, parallel with W0)

rounds.key_insight: Data not yet ready = rare window to freeze all thresholds before seeing results. Once data arrives, any threshold set post-hoc permanently loses credibility (run01 F failure mode).
rounds.critical_path: W2-1 (L) determines total timeline; all W3/W5 items depend on it
rounds.number_direction: 23 of 24 items predict weaker headline numbers; 1 item (W4-6 stability lambda path) may strengthen frequency but exposes true error rate

core_claims: Current pipeline has 3 design-level problems: estimand identity crisis, shrinkage-where-projection-needed, mismatched control arms
24 fix items across 6 waves; 7 items form minimum viable fix set
Pure function refactoring (W2-1) is the sole L and the critical path bottleneck
All thresholds must be frozen before data arrives (irreversible credibility window)
evidence_requirements: Outer maxT permutation (W3-1) is the only tool that can validate the headline max statistic
Shadow columns must walk identical Stage 1 path as real descriptors (W3-2)
random-k / bottom-k control validation set (W3-6) is cheapest supporting evidence available
experiment_plan: Wave 0+1: can start immediately, all pre-data, ~1 week
Wave 2: the L item, ~1-2 weeks, blocks Wave 3 and 5
Wave 3+4: parallel during/after W2-1, ~1 week each
final_consensus.narrative_structure: Post-fix claims are weaker but defensible: 'descriptor X shows within-system monotonic association at maxT percentile Y, with BCa interval Z (excluding selection uncertainty)'

top_3_recommendations: Put a permutation loop at the outermost layer so the entire selection chain enters the null distribution (system-internal joint row permutation, re-run Stage 1-4 completely)
Fix the adjustment layer: replace shrinkage with projection (alpha=0 / pinv), bilateral residualization (both x and y), one declared estimand per column name

Match every control arm to its treatment arm: permuted shadow features for noise baseline, shared permutation for V1, minimum-n gate + exact permutation p-values for V3, validate random-k and bottom-k candidates alongside top-k
cross_cutting_issues: Estimand identity — 5 different 'Spearman' quantities compared as if commensurable
Shrinkage where projection needed — alpha>0 on categorical confounders biases toward conclusion
Single-column X makes model layer inert — Ridge/Scaler/alpha have zero effect on rank metrics
Control arms from different populations than treatment arms
Unexecuted computations encoded as favorable values rather than missing
Sign conventions differ at every layer — Simpson reversal (the most diagnostic signal) is destroyed
Rank transform applied after non-rank-preserving operations — Spearman rationale doesn't transfer
Missingness is an unacknowledged covariate — search systematically prefers small-support candidates
Config drift is an algorithm-level defect — documented algorithm != executed algorithm
